name: Chamera Lake
description: Reservoir lake 25 km from Dalhousie. Boating, kayaking, and surrounding forested hills.

name: Dainkund Peak
description: Highest point in Dalhousie at 2,755 meters. Trek through forests to Pholani Devi Temple at the summit.

name: Kalatop Wildlife Sanctuary
description: Dense deodar forest sanctuary with trekking trails. Home to Himalayan black bear, barking deer, and goral.

name: Khajjiar (Mini Switzerland)
description: Saucer-shaped plateau at 6,500 ft with dense forests and a small lake. Called Mini Switzerland of India.

name: Mall Road & Gandhi Chowk
description: Colonial-era main street with shops, eateries, and views of Dhauladhar and Pir Panjal ranges.

name: Panchpula
description: Five bridges area with a waterfall. Memorial of freedom fighter Sardar Ajit Singh. Forest walk.

name: Satdhara Falls
description: Seven streams of water falling from a height surrounded by pine forests. Believed to have medicinal properties.

name: St. John's Church
description: Victorian-era church built in 1863 with beautiful stained glass windows and stone architecture.

name: Alpine Meadows & Prayer Flags
description: Open meadows at 2,800–3,000m with prayer flags and panoramic views of eastern Himalayas.

name: Madhuri Lake (Sangetsar Tso)
description: Beautiful lake formed by the 1950 earthquake. Named after Bollywood actress who shot a song here.

name: Nuranang Falls (Bong Bong Falls)
description: 100-meter waterfall near Tawang. Featured in the Bollywood movie "Koyla". Hydroelectric project at base.

name: Sela Pass
description: Mountain pass at 13,700 ft with Sela Lake. Snow-covered for most of the year with stunning views.

name: Tawang Monastery
description: Largest monastery in India and second-largest in the world after Lhasa. 400-year-old Gelug sect gompa at 10,000 ft.

name: Tawang War Memorial
description: Memorial honoring soldiers who died in the 1962 Sino-Indian War. Museum with war artifacts and gallery.

name: Urgelling Gompa
description: Birthplace of the 6th Dalai Lama, Tsangyang Gyatso. Small but historically significant monastery.

name: Billing Takeoff Site
description: World's second-highest paragliding site at 8,000 ft. Used for Paragliding World Cup events.

name: Bir Tea Garden & Factory
description: Organic tea gardens where you can see tea processing and buy fresh Kangra tea directly.

name: Chokling Monastery
description: Beautiful Tibetan Buddhist monastery with ornate architecture and a meditation center.

name: Sherabling Monastery
description: One of the most important Kagyu monasteries in India. Peaceful campus with resident monks.

name: Khecheopalri Lake
description: Sacred "Wish-Fulfilling Lake" revered by Buddhists and Hindus. No leaves are allowed to float on the surface.

name: Pelling Skywalk
description: Glass-floor skywalk at 7,200 ft with 360-degree views of Kanchenjunga and surrounding peaks.

name: Pemayangtse Monastery
description: One of Sikkim's oldest monasteries (1705). Houses an extraordinary 7-tier wooden sculpture of heaven.

name: Rabdentse Ruins
description: Ruins of the second capital of Sikkim (1670-1814). Short forest trek to the ruins with Kanchenjunga views.

name: Adalaj Stepwell
description: Five-storey ornamental stepwell from 1499 with over 500 carved figures. Stays cool even in Gujarat's scorching summers.

name: Akshardham Temple
description: Grand pink sandstone temple complex with boat ride depicting 10,000 years of Indian culture, water show, and exhibitions.

name: Indroda Nature Park
description: India's only dinosaur and fossil park. Dinosaur egg fossils, giant whale skeleton, botanical garden, and zoo.

name: Hindola Mahal (Swing Palace)
description: T-shaped walls that slope inward giving it a swinging appearance. Unique medieval architecture.

name: Jahaz Mahal
description: Ship-like palace between two lakes built by Ghiyasuddin Khalji. 120 meters long, appears to float on water.

name: Rani Roopmati Pavilion
description: Hilltop pavilion with panoramic views of the Narmada Valley. Love story of Baz Bahadur and Roopmati.

name: Dumas Beach
description: Black sand beach on the Arabian Sea. Famous for ghost legends. Popular evening hangout with street food stalls.

name: Dutch & English Cemetery
description: Ornate colonial tombs from the 17th-18th century when Surat was India's biggest trading port.

name: Surat Street Food Trail
description: Legendary food culture — locho, undhiyu, ghari, surti sev khamani. Night market near Chowk Bazaar.

name: Bhimtal Aquarium
description: India's only freshwater aquarium built on an island in the middle of Bhimtal Lake.

name: Bhimtal Lake
description: Largest lake in Nainital district with an island aquarium in the center. Boating and kayaking available.

name: Narsingh Temple
description: Sacred Badrinath winter seat temple. One of the four cardinal math established by Adi Shankaracharya.

name: Tapovan Hot Springs
description: Natural hot springs at the confluence of Dhauli Ganga and Rishi Ganga. Believed to have healing properties.

name: Bhootnath Temple
description: Ancient Shiva temple at the heart of Mandi town built by Ajber Sen dynasty. Ornate stone carvings.

name: Rewalsar Lake
description: Sacred floating reed lake revered by Hindus, Buddhists, and Sikhs. Padmasambhava meditated here before going to Tibet.

name: Natha Top
description: Meadow at 6,633 ft with panoramic views of Pir Panjal range. Paragliding and skiing destination.

name: Sanasar Lake & Meadow
description: Cup-shaped meadow with a small lake surrounded by conifers. Adventure sports hub with zip-lining.

name: Sajnekhali Watchtower
description: Watchtower and interpretation center in the Sundarbans. Spot crocodiles, deer, and water monitors.

name: Sundarbans Boat Safari
description: UNESCO World Heritage mangrove delta. Boat safari to spot Royal Bengal tigers, crocodiles, and Gangetic dolphins.

name: Binsar Wildlife Sanctuary
description: Dense oak and rhododendron forest sanctuary with 200+ bird species. Zero Point offers 300 km Himalayan panorama.

name: Gagron Fort
description: UNESCO World Heritage hill and water fort at the confluence of Ahu and Kali Sindh rivers. Rare water fort.

name: Neemrana Fort Palace
description: 15th-century heritage fort hotel with zip-lining across ramparts. 6 palace levels built on Aravalli hills.

name: Rockfort Ucchi Pillayar Temple
description: Ancient Ganesh temple atop a 273-foot rock fortress in central Trichy. 437 carved steps wind through the rock to the summit. Panoramic views of the Kaveri River and city below. Open 6 AM–8 PM.
